headline: CISA pressed enterprises to patch Java4Shell as researchers narrowed the OpenJDK flaw to AVX-512 processors, while attackers already executed code on Perforce Puppet and Apache Roller servers and poisoned Microsoft's own agent-framework package on PyPI.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep entering through the code enterprises already trust, injecting malware into Optimizely's experimentation scripts one day and poisoning Microsoft's agent-framework releases on PyPI the next, which turns routine vendor updates into a delivery channel.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Poisoned Agent Framework Steals Cloud Keys

emerging_trends.text: Cold Relic shows how one compromised Google Workspace tenant funds the next intrusion, because stolen correspondence supplies the names, projects, and tone that make follow-on phishing land inside a partner's inbox.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Cold Relic Turns One Cloud Breach Into Two

emerging_trends.text: Three flagship systems—NSANet, Japan's Fugaku supercomputer, and Apple's iCloud Mail—stopped serving users inside a day, and only the Fugaku shutdown traces to a confirmed breach, which pushes responders to establish cause before executives name an attacker.

topics.title: Java4Shell Narrows to AVX-512 Chips
topics.latest_developments: Cisco Talos scored Java4Shell at 9.2 under CVSS 4.0, and researchers pinned down its reach: the vulnerable code runs only on Java 17.0.6 and later and only on x86-64 Intel and AMD processors that support the AVX-512 VBMI feature, with Calif demonstrating remote code execution against Jira, Jenkins, and Keycloak while VulnCheck says a working attack takes per-target engineering and no one has yet confirmed a successful intrusion.
topics.summary: CVE-2026-114938 is an out-of-bounds write in the Base64 decoder of OpenJDK that hands an unauthenticated attacker denial of service or code execution on Jenkins, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, Keycloak, and other Java servers reaching most of the Fortune 500. Oracle and the OpenJDK project released fixes on November 17, 2026, and CISA tells organizations to patch immediately.

sources.title: CVE-2026-114938: Critical vulnerability in OpenJDK JAVA
Java4Shell OpenJDK flaw: Exploitation is tricky and hinges on specific CPUs (CVE-2026-114938)
Java4Shell Vulnerability Puts Many Enterprise Applications at Risk of Takeover
Java4Shell Flaw Threatens Global Enterprises, Java Application Ecosystem

topics.title: Poisoned Agent Framework Steals Cloud Keys
topics.latest_developments: Attackers published malicious versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 of Microsoft's agent-framework package to PyPI 33 minutes apart on November 17, 2026, each one running a credential stealer every time Python starts and shipping out Azure, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions credentials, with Aikido, Chainguard, Endor Labs, OX Security, SafeDep, Socket, StepSecurity, and Wiz all reporting the compromise.
topics.summary: agent-framework is Microsoft's Python library for building AI agents, and any developer or build pipeline that installed the two poisoned releases handed over its cloud and CI credentials. Pin and audit package versions, rotate Azure and GitHub Actions secrets, and check Docker Hub images for exposed keys, which researchers watched attackers extract within eight seconds of publication.

sources.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Releases Poisoned With Credential Stealer
Attackers Compromise Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI Package to Steal Cloud Credentials
Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI package compromised to steal credentials
Cloud keys leaked in Docker Hub images are stolen within seconds

topics.title: Optimizely Attackers A/B Tested Their Malware
topics.latest_developments: Krebs on Security reported that the intruders used Optimizely's own experimentation machinery to A/B test which malware worked best on visitors to 178 top websites, and Ars Technica detailed the payload mix—cryptocurrency theft code and iOS exploits among it—served to readers of the BBC, CNN, Equifax, Ledger, and Zoom over roughly 24 hours.
topics.summary: Optimizely confirmed that an unauthorized party exploited a flaw in its Experimentation product and injected malicious JavaScript into customer projects, which the customers' sites then ran against their own visitors. Few of those sites enforce integrity checks on third-party scripts, so site owners should pin script hashes and keep vendor code away from checkout and login pages.

sources.title: Attackers Used Optimizely to A/B Test Malware on Top Websites
Hundreds of websites deliver potent malware cocktail to unsuspecting visitors
Borrowed Code, Real Consequences: What OPTIMJACK Teaches Us
Optimizely Malware Attacks Highlight Third-Party Vendor Risks

topics.title: Puppet and Roller Fall to Live Exploits
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek spelled out the mechanism behind CVE-2026-115731, the Perforce Puppet flaw rated 9.4 that CISA added to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog: any client holding a certificate signed by the Puppet certificate authority can run code on the server; the Apache Software Foundation separately warned that attackers are exploiting a critical Roller remote code execution bug and shipped updates, while Oracle's November 2026 patch update closed 950 vulnerabilities, more than 300 of them remotely exploitable without authentication, and Google released Chrome 158 with 204 fixes.
topics.summary: Perforce Puppet runs configuration management across enterprise fleets, so code execution on the Puppet server reaches every managed host; Apache Roller is a Java blog server. Patch both now, pull Oracle's 62 critical fixes, and push Chrome 158 to endpoints.

sources.title: Critical Perforce Puppet RCE Exploited in Attacks
Apache warns of Roller RCE vulnerability exploited in attacks
Oracle Patches 950 Vulnerabilities With November 2026 CSPU
Chrome 158 Patches 204 Vulnerabilities

topics.title: NSANet and Fugaku Go Dark
topics.latest_developments: The National Security Agency entered a second day of disruption on NSANet, its classified internal network, with staggered arrivals and logins at Fort Meade while a source told The Record that classified national security work continued unimpeded; Japan's RIKEN Center for Computational Science kept the Fugaku supercomputer off the network after a security breach, and Apple worked through disruptions to iCloud Mail, iCloud Account and Sign In, Apple School Manager, and Schoolwork.
topics.summary: Three high-profile systems stopped serving users inside two days, and only the Fugaku shutdown traces to a confirmed breach. Vendor silence, staged recovery, and the absence of attacker claims usually point to a failed update rather than an intrusion, so responders should establish cause before an organization attributes an outage to hacking.

sources.title: Classified Communications Network at the National Security Agency Goes Down, Defense Official Says
NSA continues response to interruptions in classified internal network
Japan takes Fugaku supercomputer offlline after cyberattack
Apple reports outages affecting iCloud Mail, AppleCare and more

topics.title: Cold Relic Turns One Cloud Breach Into Two
topics.latest_developments: Google's Mandiant and Threat Intelligence Group reported that Cold Relic, the Russia-linked espionage group formerly tracked as COLDRIVER and UNC4057, took data from a compromised Google Workspace tenant at one United States organization in 2026 and used it to break into a second United States organization, and SecurityWeek added that the group, which Microsoft tracks as Star Blizzard, impersonated an employee of the firm it hacked in late 2025 to make the follow-on phishing credible against that employee's professional network.
topics.summary: Cold Relic collects credentials and documents from cloud accounts and mines them for the relationships that open the next victim. Organizations sharing Workspace or Microsoft 365 collaboration with a breached partner should assume the attacker read that correspondence and reset federated trust and tokens accordingly.

sources.title: Russian COLD RELIC Hackers Use Stolen Google Workspace Data to Breach Second U.S. Organization
Russian APT Poses as Employee of Hacked Firm to Breach Another US Organization
Russian cyber-espionage group used stolen cloud data to hack into organizations, Google says

topics.title: Equinor and the IIHF Absorb Attacks
topics.latest_developments: Equinor, the Norwegian state-controlled oil and gas company, is containing a cyberattack on its IT systems that disrupted internal services and left oil and gas production running, while the International Ice Hockey Federation confirmed an attack that replaced its homepage with a pro-Russian message protesting Russia's exclusion from international competitions, and United States intelligence agencies reached a low-confidence assessment that Iran carried out the refrigeration system attacks in France.
topics.summary: Energy operators and sports bodies alike now draw politically motivated intrusions, from quiet enterprise IT compromise at Equinor to a defacement meant for an audience. Operators should keep corporate IT separated from operational technology and rehearse the public communications that follow a visible attack.

Ice hockey governing body website defaced amid dispute over Russia's exclusion

topics.title: Scattered Spider Ringleader Draws Six Years
topics.latest_developments: A United States court sentenced Tyler Robert Buchanan, 24, of Dundee, Scotland, to six years in prison for stealing $11.6 million in cryptocurrency and conspiring to hack a dozen companies, which closes out the American case against Scattered Spider with the last of five defendants sentenced, the Department of Justice said.
topics.summary: Investigators have described Buchanan as the suspected ringleader of Scattered Spider, the English-speaking crew Microsoft calls one of the most dangerous financial criminal groups, which runs help desk impersonation and SIM swapping to take over employee accounts. Enterprises facing this playbook should harden identity verification at the help desk and require phishing-resistant authentication for account recovery.

sources.title: British hacker gets 6 year sentence for $11.6M crypto theft scheme
Last of Five Defendants Sentenced in US Scattered Spider Hacking Case
British Scattered Spider hacker sentenced to 6 years in prison

topics.title: Malware C2 Moves Onto Public Blockchains
topics.latest_developments: Cisco Talos published its analysis of bulletproof dead drops, the practice of parking command-and-control addresses in public blockchain transactions that no takedown can reach, and named UAT-12643, a financially motivated group it suspects aligns with North Korea, which pairs that blockchain resilience with targeted infostealing.
topics.summary: Blockchain dead drops remove the single points of failure—hosting providers, registrars, hardcoded domains—that law enforcement seizes in operations like Endgame, since a read from a public ledger looks like ordinary traffic. Defenders should monitor outbound calls to blockchain RPC endpoints and treat them as command-and-control candidates on servers with no business reason to make them.

sources.title: The challenge of defending against bulletproof dead drops on public blockchains
UAT-12643: Suspected North Korea-aligned actor blends blockchain resilience with targeted infostealing

topics.title: A Flash Chip Attack Cracks BitLocker PINs
topics.latest_developments: Researchers at Technische Universität Berlin showed that anyone who opens a PC case can reset the TPM lockout that limits guesses at Windows Hello and BitLocker PINs on AMD-based machines and some Intel machines, and in lab tests they recovered a four-digit Hello PIN on an AMD laptop and a six-digit BitLocker PIN on an Intel laptop in days.
topics.summary: The trusted platform module normally throttles PIN guessing, and clearing that counter turns a short PIN into a brute-force problem small enough to finish over a long weekend, which puts stolen and lost laptops at risk. Organizations relying on BitLocker PINs should require long passphrases, add pre-boot protections beyond the PIN, and treat physical access to a device as a full compromise path.

sources.title: New Attack Bypasses TPM Lockout to Crack Windows Hello and BitLocker PINs in Days, Not Years

business_politics.title: Democrats Nominate Jeffries for Speaker
business_politics.latest_developments: House Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries for speaker in a closed-door secret ballot Wednesday, November 18, with no declared opponent against him.
business_politics.summary: Jeffries, the 56-year-old Brooklyn Democrat who has led House Democrats since 2023, worked through the fall to tamp down caucus dissent after the party's large midterm gains. He stands on track to become the first Black lawmaker to hold the gavel when the new Congress convenes in January, which puts him in charge of the chamber that writes tax, spending, and financial legislation.

sources.title: House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries won his party's nomination for speaker in a closed-door vote with no declared opponent
Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries as US House Speaker

business_politics.title: Waller Pushes a Supersized December Increase
business_politics.latest_developments: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller repeated his call Wednesday, November 18, for an outsized interest rate increase at the December meeting, which lifted Treasury yields, while the euro slid against the dollar as pressure returned to French and peripheral eurozone government bonds.
business_politics.summary: Hawkish Fed messaging has run through markets for two weeks, with policymakers weighing a larger-than-usual increase after strong jobs, growth, and inflation readings. Higher Treasury yields and a firmer dollar tighten financing conditions for borrowers worldwide and squeeze eurozone sovereign spreads.

sources.title: Treasury Yields Rise Amid Hawkish Fedspeak
Euro's Weakness Continues; Eurozone Bond Yields Fall

business_politics.title: Iran Widens Gulf Attacks to Kuwait
business_politics.latest_developments: Iran fired on a United States air base in Kuwait Wednesday, November 18, and launched several attacks on Bahrain, widening a campaign that until now centered on Bahrain and shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
business_politics.summary: Tehran struck the two Gulf monarchies in apparent retaliation for American strikes the day before, a day after it set a natural gas tanker ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz, through which a fifth of the world's seaborne oil moves. A quiet United States bombing campaign against Iran continues, putting Gulf host governments, energy shipments, and insurance markets in the middle of the fight.

sources.title: Iran Attacks Kuwait and Bahrain, Further Escalating Fight Over Strait

business_politics.title: Nvidia's Results Steady the AI Trade
business_politics.latest_developments: United States tech stocks gave back an early rally and slid Wednesday, November 18, hours after Nvidia raised its forecast and interim Chief Executive Colette Kress told investors "it's business as usual," and attention shifted to Anthropic, whose bankers plan to lift the price on its initial public offering.
business_politics.summary: Nvidia reported that revenue doubled last quarter and lifted next year's guidance in its first results since Jensen Huang resigned and the board installed finance chief Kress as interim chief. The company still carries a Securities and Exchange Commission disclosure investigation, congressional scrutiny of its China sales, and an unfinished search for a permanent chief, so the questions about its future outlast the quarter.

business_politics.title: Trump, Xi, and Putin Meet in China
business_politics.latest_developments: Xi Jinping greeted President Trump with a hug on his arrival in Shenzhen Wednesday, November 18, the Kremlin said Trump and Vladimir Putin already held an informal meeting there, and Xi told business executives that the Asia-Pacific needs more open trade while Putin condemned Western sanctions.
business_politics.summary: The three leaders convene on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen, China's answer to Silicon Valley, with Russia pressing for a signed joint statement and the war in Ukraine, Chinese trade, and American chip export controls on the table. No meeting has ever seated the American, Chinese, and Russian heads of state together.

business.title: Highmark's Insurance Arm Swings to $673 Million
business.latest_developments: Highmark Health Plans posted a $673 million profit, WPXI reported Wednesday, November 18, and Chief Financial Officer Carl Daley said one segment of the business remains in a multiyear turnaround.
business.summary: Highmark Health Plans sells coverage to roughly 7 million members across Pennsylvania, Delaware, West Virginia, and New York for Pittsburgh-based Highmark Health, the parent of Allegheny Health Network. The swing to profit follows a stretch of losses in the insurance unit, and Daley's turnaround language signals more work ahead on pricing and medical costs.

sources.title: Highmark Health Plans swings to $673M profit while one segment faces a 'multiyear turnaround'

business.title: A $937,500 Grant for the Westinghouse Site
business.latest_developments: Pennsylvania approved a $937,500 grant Wednesday, November 18, for environmental assessment and cleanup at the former Westinghouse East Pittsburgh Works, with leasable space as the goal.
business.summary: The East Pittsburgh plant, where Westinghouse Electric built generators and transformers for much of the 20th century, has sat largely idle and contaminated along the Turtle Creek valley. The grant pays for the testing and remediation that must come before any tenant signs a lease.

sources.title: Nearly $1M approved to remediate former Westinghouse East Pittsburgh Works site, create leased space

business.title: The New Terminal Turns One
business.latest_developments: Pittsburgh International Airport holds a program Wednesday, November 18, marking the first anniversary of its $1.7 billion terminal and the building's effect on the region.
business.summary: The terminal opened in November 2025, consolidating ticketing, security, and baggage into a single building reachable without the airport's underground train. Airport leadership has sold the project as a driver of flights, jobs, and development around Findlay and Moon townships in Allegheny County.

sources.title: Pittsburgh International Airport to mark first anniversary of its new terminal on Wednesday

business.title: Waymo Pulls Robotaxis Off Freeways
business.latest_developments: Waymo suspended all driverless rides on freeways Wednesday, November 18, after California barred the company's vehicles from state freeways following recent traffic incidents.
business.summary: Waymo, the Alphabet robotaxi company, has started hiring and training maintenance crews for a Pittsburgh fleet, which makes California's restriction a marker of how far the service can go here. Freeway driving decides whether robotaxis can handle airport and cross-river trips rather than city-street rides alone.

sources.title: Waymo suspends all driverless taxi rides on freeways after ban in California

business.title: Murrysville Tables the Meijer Vote
business.latest_developments: Murrysville Council tabled its decision Tuesday night, November 17, after residents at a public hearing questioned whether the plan needs changes.
business.summary: Meijer wants to build a grocery superstore and a gas station at Route 22 and Manor Road in Murrysville, Westmoreland County, and Tuesday's hearing was supposed to cover the gas station alone. Residents used it to challenge the wider site plan, pushing any approval into next year.

Murrysville Council tables vote on Meijer gas station
Murrysville residents question if current plans to build a Meijer need adjusted

business.title: Unions Press the Downtown Tax Zone
business.latest_developments: Labor union members rallied outside Allegheny County Council Tuesday, November 17, demanding job protections inside the transit revitalization investment district package before council approves it.
business.summary: The district would divert a share of future tax revenue in downtown Pittsburgh into redevelopment, and building and service unions want the legislation to guarantee union wages and jobs on the work it finances. Council holds the vote that decides how much of that money the city's office core can tap.

sources.title: Union members urge Allegheny County to protect jobs with special tax zone to revitalize Downtown
Pittsburgh union members push for approval of job protections in TRID proposal

around_town.title: Allegheny County Leads the State in Plate Readers
around_town.latest_developments: NEXTpittsburgh reported Wednesday, November 18, that Allegheny County holds more automated license plate readers than any other Pennsylvania county.
around_town.summary: The cameras sit on poles at intersections and highway ramps across the county and photograph every car that passes, feeding databases that police departments search. The spread raises the question of how long those records sit and who may run them.

sources.title: Allegheny County has more license plate readers than any other Pa. county. Here's what's at stake

around_town.title: Two Nights of Lane Closings in the Bathtub
around_town.latest_developments: PennDOT announced overnight lane restrictions on westbound Interstate 376 through the Bathtub section of the Parkway East starting Wednesday night, November 18, and running two nights, weather permitting.
around_town.summary: The Bathtub carries Parkway East traffic below grade past downtown Pittsburgh toward the Fort Pitt Tunnel, and construction there squeezes the only straight route between the eastern suburbs and the city. Drivers heading west late at night should expect single-lane backups.

sources.title: Construction to restrict traffic on Bathtub section of Parkway East for 2 nights

around_town.title: Amtrak Doubles the Pennsylvanian
around_town.latest_developments: Amtrak's second daily Pennsylvanian round trip between Pittsburgh and New York began carrying passengers Wednesday, November 18, stopping at Harrisburg and Philadelphia along the way.
around_town.summary: The Pennsylvanian has run once a day across the state, stopping at Greensburg on its way east through Philadelphia to New York. A second frequency gives Western Pennsylvania riders a choice of departure times for the first time in decades.

sources.title: Amtrak adds 2nd daily Pennsylvanian train between Pittsburgh, New York
All aboard: Amtrak's second Pittsburgh-New York route is now running

around_town.title: PublicSource Opens Up the City Budget
around_town.latest_developments: PublicSource published an explainer Wednesday, November 18, on how it built its Pittsburgh Budget Explorer, what role artificial intelligence played in the work, and what readers should keep in mind when using it.
around_town.summary: The tool lets residents search Mayor Corey O'Connor's proposed 2027 city budget, which City Council spent Tuesday hearing testimony on, much of it over cuts to the Stop the Violence and Housing Opportunity trust funds. Council must adopt a final budget by the end of December.

sources.title: About Pittsburgh Budget Explorer

around_town.title: Westmoreland Voters Stick With Touch Screens
around_town.latest_developments: Westmoreland County Election Bureau Director Scott Ross said Wednesday, November 18, that 3.5% of the nearly 112,000 voters who went to the county's 306 precincts on Election Day this month marked paper ballots.
around_town.summary: Westmoreland gives voters a choice between hand-marked paper ballots and touch-screen machines that print a paper record, and the touch screens keep winning by a wide margin. The split matters in a county whose election office has fielded years of argument over voting equipment.

sources.title: Westmoreland voters continue to opt for touch-screen devices over paper ballots

around_town.title: Foggy Mornings, Sunny Afternoons
around_town.latest_developments: Patchy fog cleared into sunshine around Pittsburgh Wednesday morning, November 18, with highs reaching the upper 50s, and WPXI calls it the coolest day of the week.
around_town.summary: WTAE holds the same pattern of fog at dawn and sun in the afternoon across Western Pennsylvania through the next few days, with temperatures climbing from here. Drivers on the valley roads south and east of the city face the thickest of the early fog.

sources.title: Patchy morning fog before sunshine warms temps into the upper-50s

around_town.title: West Mifflin Consolidation Draws a Petition
around_town.latest_developments: PublicSource reported Wednesday, November 18, that the West Mifflin Area School District's school consolidation proposal has produced a petition calling for the superintendent's termination.
around_town.summary: The district has floated closing and combining buildings, and parents say the plan arrived with too little explanation. The fight revives longer-running complaints about district leadership in the Allegheny County community.

sources.title: West Mifflin school closures plan draws call for superintendent's termination

around_town.title: Three Boroughs Hold the Line on Taxes
around_town.latest_developments: Aspinwall and Fox Chapel officials said Wednesday, November 18, that their 2027 budgets carry no property tax increase, and Etna cut its proposed increase in half.
around_town.summary: Aspinwall plans to hold millage flat, Fox Chapel intends to keep programs and services intact without a rise, and Etna continues work on a budget whose tax increase has already shrunk. All three Allegheny County boroughs must adopt final budgets by the end of December.

Etna cuts proposed property tax increase in half as work on 2027 budget continues

events.title: Light Up Night Leads the Weekend
events.latest_developments: NEXTpittsburgh published its weekend guide Wednesday, November 18, covering Thursday, November 19, through Sunday, November 22, with more than 13 things to do.
events.summary: The guide leads with Light Up Night downtown, Holiday Magic at Phipps Conservatory and Botanical Gardens in Oakland, and a Cryptid Film Festival, and fills out with fall festivals, craft markets, art openings, and theater around the city.

sources.title: 13+ things to do this weekend, from Light Up Night and Phipps Holiday Magic to a Cryptid Film Festival

events.summary: The Grammy-nominated singer and songwriter comes back to the Uptown arena, her first Pittsburgh date since her last tour stop here.

sources.title: Jhené Aiko returns to PPG Paints Arena in 2027

events.title: The Historic House Hop Returns November 28
events.latest_developments: TribLive reported Wednesday, November 18, that the Historic House Hop in Washington, Pennsylvania, returns Saturday, November 28, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.
events.summary: The hop walks visitors through historic houses in the city of Washington, Washington County, with local history the draw at each stop.

sources.title: Historic House Hop in Washington, Pa., returns Nov. 28 with unique opportunities

events.title: Three Sauropods Come to the Carnegie
events.latest_developments: Pittsburgh Magazine reported Wednesday, November 18, that the Carnegie Museum of Natural History will soon display three sauropod fossils named Daisy, Lucky, and Lucy.
events.summary: The three dinosaurs lived about 150 million years ago and arrive in Oakland on a decades-long loan that Kenneth C. Griffin facilitated, joining a hall already built on the museum's Diplodocus carnegii.

sources.title: Three New Dinosaurs Will Soon Be On Display in Pittsburgh

events.title: Delmont Sets Its Holidaze Date
events.latest_developments: Delmont officials said Wednesday, November 18, that Toys for Pittsburgh Tikes will partner with the borough on this year's Holidaze event.
events.summary: Holidaze runs Sunday, December 13, 2026, at Faith Global Methodist Church in Delmont, Westmoreland County, where Santa gives every child a present and each gets a chance to win a new bicycle. Toys for Pittsburgh Tikes, which recently moved to the borough, supplies the gifts.

sources.title: Toys for Pittsburgh Tikes partners with its new hometown on Holidaze event

around_teams.title: Heyward's Show Turns to Philadelphia
around_teams.latest_developments: Not Just Football with Cam Heyward posted a full episode Wednesday morning, November 18, that moves past the Cincinnati trip to the Philadelphia Eagles and marks the show passing 70,000 subscribers with a giveaway of Heyward's game-worn cleats.
around_teams.summary: Cam Heyward and co-host Hayden walk through the loss at Paycor Stadium, Ja'Marr Chase's production against the Steelers secondary, and guard Mason McCormick's ankle injury, then preview the Week 11 game at Philadelphia Sunday, November 22. around_teams.title: Kuntz Delivers Super Bowl Tickets to Canon-Mac
around_teams.latest_developments: The Steelers posted video Tuesday night, November 17, of long snapper Christian Kuntz handing Canon-McMillan head football coach Mike Evans tickets to Super Bowl LXI.
around_teams.summary: Evans, a cancer survivor who coaches at Canon-McMillan High School in Washington County, got the surprise from the team and Kuntz, a Mt. Lebanon native in his sixth season as the Steelers' long snapper.

sources.title: Christian Kuntz helped us surprise Canon-Mac Football Coach Mike Evans with Super Bowl LXI tickets

team_usa.title: Coffey Returns for World Cup Qualifying
team_usa.latest_developments: U.S. Soccer named midfielder Sam Coffey to the United States women's national team roster for World Cup qualifying Wednesday, November 18, bringing her back for a camp that assembles later this month.
team_usa.summary: Coach Emma Hayes takes the squad into the Concacaf W Championship, the tournament that decides the United States place at the 2027 World Cup, without defender Naomi Girma, whom Chelsea has ruled out with an injury. Coffey anchors the midfield alongside the attacking core Hayes has built since the Paris Olympics.

team_usa.title: Hayes Joins the Men's Coaching Search
team_usa.latest_developments: Emma Hayes said Wednesday, November 18, that she will help U.S. Soccer search for the next men's national team head coach, judging candidates "through a technical lens."
team_usa.summary: Hayes coaches the United States women's team and now lends her judgment to the federation's hunt for a replacement for Mauricio Pochettino, who reported for his first day at Manchester United the same day and asked fans there for time. Steve Cherundolo runs the men's December camp on an interim basis, with a Concacaf Nations League semifinal against Mexico waiting.

team_usa.latest_developments: USA Basketball announced its roster Wednesday, November 18, for FIBA World Cup qualifying games late this month.
team_usa.summary: The United States stands on the verge of clinching a World Cup berth and plays the qualifying window with a roster drawn outside the NBA's in-season player pool. Two wins in the window would settle the Americans' place in the tournament.

sources.title: USA Basketball announces roster for World Cup qualifying games in Nov.

team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN published early power rankings for the 2030 World Cup Wednesday, November 18, keeping Spain first after England's win over the Spaniards and placing the United States men's national team outside the top 15.
team_usa.summary: The ranking lands as U.S. Soccer searches for a head coach to replace Mauricio Pochettino, who left for Manchester United, with Steve Cherundolo running the December camp. team_usa.summary: The win gave Rafael Márquez his first victory as Mexico's coach and snapped a five-game winless run, and it hands the United States its oldest rival in the next round. Whoever the Americans hire to replace Mauricio Pochettino inherits that fixture.

sources.title: Mexico edge Jamaica for first win under Márquez, set up Nations League semi vs. U.S.

reading.title: Nvidia Earnings; Office Convergence; OS Wars, AI Edition
reading.summary: Ben Thompson reads Nvidia's uneventful quarter as the clearest argument that the board has no reason to bring Jensen Huang back. He then takes up competing operating-system updates from Microsoft and Anthropic and what their convergence means for office software.

reading.author: Ed Zitron
reading.title: The NVIDIA Bubble
reading.summary: Zitron argues Nvidia's revenue rests on a small circle of capital-spending customers whose own economics do not work, which makes the company the center of the artificial-intelligence bubble rather than proof against it.

reading.author: Cal Newport
reading.title: In Search of the Deep Life
reading.summary: Newport traces his pandemic-era essay streak to the idea he has pursued since: a deliberate life built around depth, craft, and attention. He lays out what that search has taught him about structuring work and time.

glance.text: Attackers keep riding trusted vendor code, injecting malware into Optimizely's experimentation scripts and publishing poisoned agent-framework builds to PyPI that steal Azure credentials every time Python starts.

glance.text: NSANet entered a second day of disruption at Fort Meade alongside Japan's Fugaku shutdown and Apple's iCloud Mail outage, with only Fugaku tied to a confirmed breach.
Mandiant traced Cold Relic from one compromised Google Workspace tenant into a partner organization, using stolen correspondence to give follow-on phishing the right names, projects, and tone.

links.title: Cold Relic Turns One Cloud Breach Into Two

glance.text: Exploitation and research keep narrowing to specific hardware and trust anchors, from CISA-listed Puppet certificate abuse to Java4Shell's AVX-512-only reach and a TPM reset that cracks BitLocker PINs.

links.title: Puppet and Roller Fall to Live Exploits
